items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: I introduced Charlie Fuqua to Deke Watson... and that's how the original Inkspots were born.

ctx.x: It probably wouldn't be Crooke; it would probably be Claude Williamson, or Charlie
Fuqua. Fuqua never actually played with the band. They travelled with the band; didn't they? He travelled with us. Fuqua was with the band when the band broke up.
